rows.commentary: 0.5: Nomvelo Sibanda delivers back of a length, angling across, allowing Shafali Verma to punch it down to sweeper cover for a single.
0.6: Nomvelo Sibanda loses control as the ball slips from her hand, delivering a high full-toss that is signalled a no ball, setting up a free hit.
0.6: Nomvelo Sibanda offers a slower, fuller delivery right in the slot, which Pratika Rawal picks cleanly and lofts through the line over the in-field to long-off for four.
1.1: Tendai Makusha hits a sharp length right on the money, nipping back in sharply as Shafali Verma blocks it watchfully.
1.2: Tendai Makusha probes on a length with inward movement, catching an early closed bat-face from Shafali Verma that trickles away off the outer half.
1.3: Tendai Makusha serves it full and wide, forcing Shafali Verma to reach out and slice her shot square of the wicket on the off-side for a single.
1.4: Tendai Makusha angles a full delivery in, prompting Pratika Rawal to step forward and drive it firmly towards the covers for one.
1.5: Tendai Makusha searches for control, pushing the delivery wide of the off-stump to Shafali Verma who lets it drift past.
1.5: Tendai Makusha completely misses her radar again with a delivery launched wide outside off, conceding back-to-back wides.
1.5: Tendai Makusha serves up a full and wide opportunity, but Shafali Verma can only find the fielder at sweeper cover for a single.
1.6: Tendai Makusha corrects her line to end the over on a length close to the off-stump, leaving Pratika Rawal to flash hard and miss as it comes in too close to the body.
2.1: Nomvelo Sibanda pitches full outside off and angles it further away, leaving Shafali Verma to watch it pass safely.
2.1: Nomvelo Sibanda delivers a back-of-a-length ball on off, and Shafali Verma steers it cleanly toward sweeper cover for a single.
2.2: Nomvelo Sibanda drops it full and angled across the batter, allowing Pratika Rawal to drive it securely out to sweeper cover for one.
2.3: Nomvelo Sibanda offers up a tempting full-toss that Shafali Verma violently lifts over the infield toward deep mid-wicket, bouncing once directly over the ropes for four.
2.4: Nomvelo Sibanda strikes as Shafali Verma holes out, with Nyasha Gwanzura safely claiming the catch to dismiss the batter for eight.
13.4: Loryn Phiri tosses it up in the slot, and Pratika Rawal leans onto the delivery, creaming it through the gap between mid-off and covers all the way to the boundary for four.
13.5: Loryn Phiri flighting it well on middle, and Pratika Rawal simply pushes the ball right back toward the bowler for a dot.
13.6: Loryn Phiri pulls back her length, allowing Pratika Rawal to step back and carve the ball away to deep extra cover for a single.
14.1: Michelle Mavunga strays onto the pads, and Pratika Rawal works it smoothly into the gap as the pair completes two runs.
14.2: Michelle Mavunga delivers it full and outside off, and Pratika Rawal steers her drive straight toward the covers.
14.3: Michelle Mavunga pulls her length slightly shorter on middle, prompting Pratika Rawal to punch off the back foot into the off-side.
14.4: Michelle Mavunga bowls fullish on off, Pratika Rawal taps it to mid-off to scamper through a quick single while beating the shy at the bowler's end.
14.5: Michelle Mavunga induces a mix-up as Harmanpreet Kaur plays it towards wide mid-on for a hurried single while Pratika Rawal tracks the flight of the ball.
14.6: Michelle Mavunga drops fractionally shorter, letting Pratika Rawal punch off the back foot to sweeper cover.
15.1: Loryn Phiri loops it up on off, and Pratika Rawal drives the ball firmly toward the cover fielder.
15.2: Loryn Phiri fires a full one too far into the slot, and Pratika Rawal punishes it past the fielders to sweeper cover, bringing up the team hundred in style.
15.3: Loryn Phiri tosses it up once more, and Pratika Rawal calmly strokes it down the ground to long-off for a single.
15.4: Loryn Phiri serves up a full-toss on the pads, which Harmanpreet Kaur flicks away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
15.5: Loryn Phiri drifts it too full on off, allowing Pratika Rawal to ease the delivery straight down to long-off.
15.6: Loryn Phiri drops it too short outside off, prompting Harmanpreet Kaur to step back and cut it toward sweeper cover.
16.1: Michelle Mavunga pitches fullish on middle, drilled straight back by Harmanpreet Kaur to crash into the bowler's stumps.
16.2: Michelle Mavunga keeps it full on middle, and Pratika Rawal simply pushes the ball right back to the bowler.
16.3: Michelle Mavunga angles one in from outside off, taking the inside half of Pratika Rawal's bat toward mid-wicket.
16.4: Michelle Mavunga digs it a fraction shorter outside off, safely cut away to point by Harmanpreet Kaur.
16.5: Michelle Mavunga targets back of a length outside off, guided deftly to third man by a late-playing Harmanpreet Kaur.
16.6: Michelle Mavunga finishes the over as Pratika Rawal nudges the delivery toward cover.
29.6: Olinder Chare strays down the leg-side, allowing Deepti Sharma to sink to one knee and sweep the loose offering firmly away to the boundary fence.
30.1: Nyasha Gwanzura drops it on a length outside off and Harmanpreet Kaur steps forward to smother it down.
30.2: Nyasha Gwanzura serves up a floated delivery in the slot outside off, which Harmanpreet Kaur reaches for and drives crisply straight to cover.
30.3: Nyasha Gwanzura targets off-stump, and Harmanpreet Kaur stays rooted in her crease to cut the ball directly to backward point.
30.4: Nyasha Gwanzura digs in a short delivery down the leg-side, resulting in a pull shot toward deep backward square for a single.
30.5: Nyasha Gwanzura offers width outside off, tempting Deepti Sharma into a cut that she mistimes toward the cover fielder.
30.6: Nyasha Gwanzura watches as Deepti Sharma sweeps the ball wide of deep backward square, settling for a single after a hesitant passage of running between the wickets.
31.1: Olinder Chare pitches it wide outside off, and Deepti Sharma slaps the ball hard but hits it straight to extra cover.
31.2: Olinder Chare gifts a juicy full toss that Deepti Sharma steps out to meet, miscues her intended slog through the midwicket region, and scampers a single.
31.3: Olinder Chare fires it short outside off, catching Harmanpreet Kaur swinging hard at a cut shot that she fails to time, securing just a single through the covers.
31.4: Olinder Chare provides width outside off once more, and Deepti Sharma patiently waits back to punch it piercingly through the off-side ring for a boundary.
31.5: Olinder Chare delivers a length ball on off-stump, prompting Deepti Sharma to drop back and punch it down to long-on for a single.
31.6: Olinder Chare serves an overpitched delivery outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur shovels it straight to short midwicket.
32.1: Nyasha Gwanzura strays down the leg-side, allowing Deepti Sharma to drop to one knee and sweep it fine past a desperate diving effort.
32.2: Nyasha Gwanzura bowls down the leg-side once more, and Deepti Sharma cashes in by sweeping it very fine past the wicketkeeper for another boundary.
32.3: Deepti Sharma works Nyasha Gwanzura cleanly off her pads into the square leg region to pick up a single.
32.4: Nyasha Gwanzura tosses it up on off stump, and Harmanpreet Kaur prods firmly down the pitch.
32.5: Harmanpreet Kaur gets forward to Nyasha Gwanzura and gently flicks the delivery through midwicket for a single.
32.6: Nyasha Gwanzura delivers an overpitched ball outside off, which Deepti Sharma drives down to long-off.
43.2: Michelle Mavunga drops it full on off stump, allowing Deepti Sharma to gently flick a single out to deep midwicket.
43.3: Michelle Mavunga angles a short delivery onto the stumps, and Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it off the thick inside half to the left of deep mid-wicket for one.
43.4: Michelle Mavunga delivers it full on leg stump, and Deepti Sharma wristily turns it away to the right of deep midwicket for a run.
43.5: Sibanda spills a third chance as Harmanpreet Kaur slices it to backward point where the diving fielder gets both hands to the ball yet fails to hold on.
43.6: Michelle Mavunga floats a very full ball just outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur gets underneath it to lift a single to the right of long-off.
44.1: Beloved Biza tests Harmanpreet Kaur who charges out to meet a full ball, slog-sweeping it toward deep midwicket where Gwanzura takes a sharp bounce just short of her face.
44.2: Beloved Biza fires it short outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur drags her pull shot away to the left of deep square.
44.3: Beloved Biza offers a full delivery outside off, and Deepti Sharma knocks her drive straight down to long-on for a comfortable single.
44.4: Beloved Biza serves it full outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur powerfully sweeps it through the gap between deep square and deep midwicket for a boundary.
44.5: Beloved Biza keeps it flat just outside off, where Harmanpreet Kaur cuts sharply but finds the diving fielder at cover point blocking the single.
44.6: Beloved Biza attacks the stumps with a full delivery, which Harmanpreet Kaur biffs down the ground to long-on for a run.
45.1: Tendai Makusha offers width outside off, allowing Harmanpreet Kaur to shuffle across, open the face of her bat, and glide a four between backward point and short third.
45.2: Tendai Makusha delivers a low full toss outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it straight to the fielder stationed at short midwicket.
45.3: Tendai Makusha pitches it fuller and wider, allowing Harmanpreet Kaur to slam her drive firmly towards deep cover.
45.4: Tendai Makusha offers a full delivery outside off, and Deepti Sharma slices her drive sharply to the right of backward point.
45.5: Tendai Makusha serves up a hittable slot ball in the channel, and Deepti Sharma gets underneath it to pump it straight back over the bowler for four.
45.6: Tendai Makusha arrows in a low full toss outside off, which Deepti Sharma pushes down the ground towards long-on for a single.
46.1: Michelle Mavunga comes into the attack and is worked away comfortably by Deepti Sharma to collect a single out at long-on.
0.1: Sayali Satghare drops it short and wide outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa pounces instantly, carving it through sweeper cover for a sharp boundary.
0.2: Sayali Satghare errs again with width and length, allowing Modester Mupachikwa to rise on her toes and slash it square across the off-side for four more.
0.3: Sayali Satghare searches for control but sprays this one down the leg-side, called wide as she wrestles with her radar.
0.3: Sayali Satghare tests the back of a length outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa quietly nudges it into the backward point region for a single.
0.4: Sayali Satghare targets the channel outside off on a length, with Loryn Phiri pushing the delivery towards the cover fielder.
0.5: Sayali Satghare keeps it short and tight to the body, prompting Loryn Phiri to step directly in line and dead-bat the threat.
0.6: Sayali Satghare invites a drive with a fuller delivery, and Loryn Phiri meets it with a straight blade, steering the block straight toward mid-off.
1.1: Jintimani Kalita lands it on a probing channel outside off, leaving Modester Mupachikwa to watch the ball sail harmlessly past.
1.2: Jintimani Kalita hits a immaculate length right on off stump, forcing Modester Mupachikwa behind the line to solidly block.
1.3: Jintimani Kalita searches for the yorker length but serves up a low full toss, which Modester Mupachikwa turns firmly toward short mid-wicket.
1.4: Jintimani Kalita overcorrects on the pads, and Modester Mupachikwa gracefully whips the full delivery through mid-wicket for a sublime boundary.
1.5: Jintimani Kalita pulls back to a fraction short outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa guides the ball cleanly to point.
1.6: Jintimani Kalita finds a tightening full length with subtle away movement, tempting Modester Mupachikwa into a drive steered straight to covers.
2.1: Sayali Satghare serves it up in the slot, Loryn Phiri drills it toward covers, and despite early hesitation the pair scampers through for a sharp single.
2.2: Sayali Satghare bangs it back of a length outside off, inviting Modester Mupachikwa to punch it firmly toward the cover region.
2.3: Sayali Satghare pitches full on off stump, and Modester Mupachikwa dead-bats her push directly to mid-off.
2.4: Sayali Satghare digs in a bouncer that sails far over the batter, drawing an immediate wide signal from the umpire.
2.4: Sayali Satghare attacks from a length with an inward angle, allowing Modester Mupachikwa to comfortably block it back to the bowler.
2.5: Sayali Satghare concedes a single as Modester Mupachikwa works the ball away toward deep backward point.
16.3: Vaishnavi Sharma feeds it short and wide, allowing Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano to pounce in a flash, carving the cut stroke cleanly behind square on the off-side for a boundary.
16.4: Vaishnavi Sharma slips through the arm ball straight on, leaving Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano completely stranded as she plays for sharp turn and gets beaten all ends up.
16.5: Vaishnavi Sharma tosses it up on off, prompting Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano to drop low and execute a delicate reverse paddle past the fielder toward third man for two runs.
16.6: Vaishnavi Sharma drifts it slower and flighted on middle, where Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano safely tucks the defensive prod away toward the leg-side.
17.1: Shafali Verma keeps it flat and close to off, offering minimal room before Modester Mupachikwa executes a sharp cut straight to point.
17.2: Shafali Verma drops it short and spinning into off, allowing Modester Mupachikwa room to carve a brisk cut wide of point for a single.
17.3: Shafali Verma drifts one onto middle and leg, prompting Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano to tickle it off her pads behind square to scamper back for a couple, bringing up the fifty-run partnership.
17.4: Shafali Verma tosses it up on a length outside off, where Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano plays with the turn to dead-bat it toward point.
17.5: Shafali Verma offers width outside off, tempting Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano into a flashy cut that entirely misses the ball.
17.6: Shafali Verma errs with width once more, and Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano waits back, plays it late, and squirts a vicious cut past backward point for four.
18.1: Vaishnavi Sharma pitches short and wide, prompting Modester Mupachikwa to slap a hard stroke toward the right of sweeper cover who smartly cuts it off.
18.2: Vaishnavi Sharma loops up a slow length delivery that spins sharply back into middle, forcing Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano to dead-bat it gently into the on-side.

18.3: Vaishnavi Sharma loops it up to Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano, who drops to sweep and watches it balloon off the glove past the keeper before a brilliant diving save near the rope restricts them to two.
18.4: Vaishnavi Sharma tosses one up on a length outside off, and Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano deftly pushes it through point for a single.
18.5: Vaishnavi Sharma fires in a slow delivery on a length close to off, which Modester Mupachikwa solidly defends.
18.6: Vaishnavi Sharma gives it plenty of flight, and Modester Mupachikwa dances down the track, dragging an inside-half lofted shot over the infield to find the boundary.
19.1: Shafali Verma drifts one in on leg stump, prompting Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano to get low and sweep it away to deep backward square for a single.
19.2: No run for Modester Mupachikwa off Shafali Verma.
31.1: Vaishnavi Sharma loops it up outside off at sixty-six clicks, and Beloved Biza advances to loft it cleanly over mid-off for four.
31.2: Vaishnavi Sharma tosses up another sixty-five kph delivery, prompting Biza to charge again before mistiming her aerial drive toward long-on for a single.
31.3: Vaishnavi Sharma lands one on a length to turn away from Josephine Nkomo, who meets it solidly with a forward defence.
31.4: Vaishnavi Sharma draws a thick leading edge from Josephine Nkomo, squeezing a single away through the cover region.
31.5: Vaishnavi Sharma tests Biza who dances down for a big heave, dragging it off a heavy inside edge through midwicket to rotate the strike.
31.6: Vaishnavi Sharma darts one in with the arm, rapping Josephine Nkomo firmly on the thigh pad.
32.1: Deepti Sharma offers a stock delivery that Beloved Biza punches cleanly off the back foot straight to cover.
32.2: Deepti Sharma keeps it slow on a length on off stump, where Biza gets forward to dead-bat the ball.
32.3: Deepti Sharma is met with a stinging reverse-sweep from Biza, but backward point intercepts it sharply.
32.4: Deepti Sharma watches Biza charge down the track to drill her delivery straight back down the pitch.
32.5: Deepti Sharma drifts one down leg on a length, allowing Biza to tuck it neatly behind square for a single.
32.6: Deepti Sharma floats up a length ball on middle and leg, safely defended by Josephine Nkomo towards square leg.
33.1: Shree Charani drifts it in flat on middle and leg, and Beloved Biza tickles it softly behind square for a single.
33.2: Shree Charani floats one up on middle, prompting Josephine Nkomo to step forward and dead-bat it into the on-side.
33.3: Shree Charani serves it full and wide, cracked firmly by Josephine Nkomo before a brilliant diving stop denies the extra cover region.
33.4: Shree Charani targets a length on off stump, allowing Josephine Nkomo to shuffle across and work it through square leg for a comfortable single.
33.5: Shree Charani errs with a short arm-ball down leg, punishingly pulled away to the boundary behind square by Beloved Biza.
33.6: Shree Charani is eased down to long-off for a single, leaving Beloved Biza on strike as the players pause for drinks.
44.6: Sayali Satghare drops it full on off and Chiedza Dhururu sends the drive straight to Deepti positioned at mid-on.
45.1: Deepti Sharma tosses one up outside off and Nyasha Gwanzura pushes the drive to the right of cover.
45.2: Deepti Sharma slips in a short delivery as Nyasha Gwanzura hunts for the cut and catches only the top-edge.
45.3: Deepti Sharma serves up a full one that Nyasha Gwanzura clears her front leg to swipe over cow corner for a seventy-three-metre maximum, the first six of the innings.
45.4: Deepti Sharma traps Nyasha Gwanzura plumb in front of middle as the batter plays all around a hurried stroke deep in her crease for twenty.
45.5: Deepti Sharma strikes with her very next ball as Nomvelo Sibanda edges a premeditated prod straight into the welcoming hands of Tejal Hasabnis.
45.6: Deepti Sharma misses out on the hat-trick while bowling to a crowded ring of slip, leg slip, and short leg as Tendai Makusha dead-bats it into the leg-side with soft hands.
46.1: Jintimani Kalita lands a full delivery wide of off stump which Chiedza Dhururu steers with an open bat face towards cover.
46.2: Jintimani Kalita strays down the leg-side with a full delivery, leaving Chiedza Dhururu swinging into thin air for a wide.
46.2: Jintimani Kalita offers width outside off and Chiedza Dhururu slices the drive over backward point to hustle back for two runs, bringing up Zimbabwe's double century.
46.3: Jintimani Kalita fires it full on the off stump and Chiedza Dhururu toe-ends her drive directly to extra cover.
46.4: Jintimani Kalita bowls a short delivery on off that is punched straight back into the hands of the bowler.
46.5: Jintimani Kalita serves up a short half-tracker that Chiedza Dhururu ruthlessly swivels on, hammering the pull shot past the despairing dive of the square leg fielder to her left.
46.6: Jintimani Kalita keeps it tight, forcing Chiedza Dhururu to merely stroke a single out toward the sweeper cover region.
47.1: Deepti Sharma loops a slower, fuller delivery outside off, and Dhururu steps forward to steer it straight toward mid-off.
47.2: Dhururu drives right back to Deepti, who whirls around to fire a throw at the stumps, missing entirely and gifting an overthrow as the deflection rolls toward square leg.
47.3: Tendai Makusha swings wildly with zero footwork, skewing a thick leading edge straight into the hands of substitute Harleen Deol stationed at backward point.
47.4: Deepti lands a full ball on off stump, which Olinder Chare safely dead-bats into the off-side.
47.5: Chare plays with velvet hands against an offbreak on the stumps, guiding it gently into the off-side.
47.6: Deepti fires it right into the blockhole on leg stump, forcing Chare to jam it away into the leg-side.
48.1: Jintimani Kalita targets a short-of-length spot on the stumps, and Dhururu pushes the ball firmly toward cover.
48.2: Kalita entices Dhururu with a full delivery outside off, drawing a flashing drive that beats the outside edge completely.
48.3: Dhururu stands tall against a good-length ball on the stumps, presenting a dead bat for a solid block into the off-side.
48.4: Kalita attacks the channel outside off, and Dhururu chops the ball sharply to the left of cover.
48.5: Dhururu chips a length ball straight to cover where Harleen Deol takes the catch, sealing India's 121-run victory and a 2-0 series triumph while giving Kalita her maiden ODI wicket.
